info.title: Runnee Cloud developer API
info.description: Managed remote RunneeScript execution. API keys belong on trusted servers. Default global throttle: 100 requests/minute per IP; API key default: 120/minute plus route limits. Secrets: 30/minute; script writes: 20/minute, restore:10/minute. Limits can be lower; honor Retry-After. Session-only account, API-key issuance, payment mutations and administration are intentionally outside this developer contract. Execution cancellation is not available. See SDK SECURITY.md.

post.summary: Execute remotely. Defaults to dry-run. Use secrets:use for secretNames. Idempotency receipts last 24 hours; replays omit original output.
